description: Is this Japanese corporation a registered qualified invoice issuer, since when, and was it cancelled or did it expire? Give number (T1000020109142) or corporate_number (13 digits); the check digit is validated. Returns listed, expired (cancellation or expiry date passed) or unknown, with NTA's published dates, the difference file used, fetched_at and recorded changes. Corporations only. A number not seen in the recorded files is unknown, never 'not registered'.

corporate_number.description: Corporate number (houjin bangou), 13 digits, e.g. 1000020109142; looked up as T + the 13 digits

number.description: Registration number: T followed by 13 digits, e.g. T1000020109142 (width, spaces and hyphens ignored)

name: invoice_registration_lookup

nta_notice.description: Always pass on: cancellation and expiry are published facts with the dates as published, not an assessment of the business.

official_check.description: Read first: as published by NTA; check the official site listed here before relying on this answer.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

file_date.description: Creation date of the NTA difference file.

observed_at.description: When this service read the file.

corporate_number.description: The 13 digits for a corporation (combine with jp-entity-evidence or jp-gbizinfo).

corporate_number.description: The 13 digits for a corporation (combine with jp-entity-evidence or jp-gbizinfo).

registration_number.description: T followed by 13 digits, as published.

registration_status.description: Computed from the published dates against today (Japan time).

status.description: listed: A record matching the query by identifier or exact name is in the version of the official record checked (status_as_of). not_found_in_checked_records: No matching record in the version checked. It says nothing about other registries, other names or periods before tracking_since. no_longer_listed_since: A matching record was seen by this service earlier and is not in the current version since the date given. The reason is not published here and is not inferred. expired: The official record itself states an end or expiry date that has passed. The reason is not inferred. unknown: Could not be determined: not checked, data unavailable or stale, or only similar-name candidates were found (see unknown_reason).

listed = the latest recorded record shows a registration; expired = it shows a cancellation or expiry date that has passed; unknown = not in the changes recorded since tracking_since while the full file is not loaded (not_in_recorded_changes_full_file_not_loaded; never means not registered), or data not loaded, stale, still loading, or a gap.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.
